export_evidence: ImportKey (https://importkey.com/countries/india/ss-filters-private-limited) shows 126 customs records, but the visible rows are imports into India, not exports: e.g. "2026-01-21 | Nanjing Fiberglass Research Desig | SS FILTERS PRIVATE LIMITED | FILTER PAPER NK-H-69W ... | BEIJING, CHINA | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC, India | 48054000 | BOL 7017696" and "2025-12-20 | SS FILTERS PRIVATE LIMITED | BIRLA CARBON (THAILAND) PUBLIC COMP | CANDLE FILTER HOUSING ... | NHAVA SHEVA SEA, India | Laem Chabang, THAILAND | 84219900 | BOL 8061570" — the second row is an India-side import from Thailand (Indian port of arrival = Nhava Sheva), i.e. inbound. No outbound export bill of lading with an Indian port of loading and a foreign destination was seen. Source counter: page claims "Total Shipments 126 Records detected", "Trading Partners 4", "Ports 7"; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 shipment rows (plus 5 supplier rows and 5 buyer rows, which are aggregated counterparty lists, not shipment records).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved: ZaubaCorp, TheCompanyCheck and Eximpedia returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable ("Connection refused") and Bing returned only irrelevant results for the quoted name. No domestic supply record seen — but this is a retrieval failure, not a negative finding.
note: Company exists and is active in Indian customs data (address on record: B-20, Parmanu Nagar, Sec-4, Vashi, Navi Mumbai). Its documented trade activity is IMPORT of filter media/cartridges (HS 48054000 filter paper from China; HS 84219900 filter candles/housings from Thailand and Oman) — it is a filter-equipment trader/manufacturer, not a food/FMCG supplier. Declared HS 350790 (enzymes) does not match any observed record; per project rules this is not a rejection ground — actual codes observed are 48054000 and 84219900, so the code should be corrected and the verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. No export shipments and no domestic supply evidence found; следов экспортных поставок не найдено, по внутреннему рынку данных получить не удалось (источники закрыты). Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources).
